beats.headline: Shares gain 4.32% amid broad chip rally led by Intel
beats.explanation: Nvidia rose 4.32% to $208.27 on 1.8 times average volume as an upbeat quarterly report from competitor Intel ignited a broad semiconductor rally. The advance was shared across the sector, with Intel surging 23.60%, competitor AMD climbing 13.91%, and supplier TSMC advancing 5.17%.

beats.headline: Stock rises 4.00% to all-time high ahead of earnings
beats.explanation: Nvidia climbed 4.00% to close at a record $216.61 on 1.6 times average volume, pushing its market capitalization above $5 trillion ahead of major tech earnings. The move was largely company-specific as peers diverged, with competitor AMD falling 3.79% while supplier Micron gained 5.61%.

beats.headline: Shares slide 4.63% following Big Tech earnings
beats.explanation: Nvidia dropped 4.63% to $199.57 on 1.9 times average volume following Big Tech quarterly earnings and continued reports of stalled chip deliveries in China. The drop was company-specific compared to chip peers, as competitor AMD rose 5.16% and competitor Alphabet jumped 9.96%, though customer and competitor Microsoft fell 3.93%.

beats.headline: Stock jumps 4.39% on U.S. China approval and UBS target
beats.explanation: Nvidia rose 4.39% to $235.74 on 1.5 times average volume following reports that the U.S. cleared sales of its H200 chips to Chinese tech firms, alongside a UBS price target increase to $275 on strong Blackwell demand. The gain was shared with key supplier TSMC, which rose 4.48%, and competitor Broadcom, which gained 5.52%, while competitors Intel and Qualcomm fell 3.62% and 6.14% respectively.

beats.headline: Shares rally 6.26% on RTX Spark AI PC platform launch
beats.explanation: Nvidia gained 6.26% to $224.36 on 1.8 times average volume after unveiling its RTX Spark platform and Vera data center processors at GTC Taipei to target the PC market. The move was company-specific against direct chip rivals, with competitor AMD falling 1.16% and competitor Intel declining 4.67%, though suppliers Micron and TSMC moved up 6.64% and 4.11%.

beats.headline: Shares pull back 3.62% without specific catalyst
beats.explanation: Nvidia fell 3.62% to $214.75 on 1.3 times average volume with no negative company-specific news to explain the pullback following its GTC Taipei product launch. The drop was company-specific relative to chip rivals, as competitors Intel, AMD, and Qualcomm gained 4.43%, 4.02%, and 3.81% respectively, though customer and competitor Microsoft fell 3.17%.

beats.headline: Stock gains 3.65% as AI software stack expands
beats.explanation: Nvidia rose 3.65% to $204.12 on 1.2 times average volume as the company partnered with LangChain to launch NemoClaw for lower-cost enterprise AI agents. Chip stocks broadly rebounded, with competitor Broadcom rising 4.83% and supplier TSMC adding 1.02%, even as broader indexes faced geopolitical headwinds from U.S.-Iran tensions.

beats.headline: Stock advances 4.03% on Meta GPU relief and CPU notes
beats.explanation: Nvidia climbed 4.03% to $210.96 on 1.2 times average volume amid analyst relief that Meta's upcoming internal AI chip would not replace Nvidia GPUs, alongside positive Wedbush commentary on its Vera CPU. The gain was largely company-specific, with competitor AMD rising 2.04% while supplier TSMC fell 0.65% and competitor Intel declined 2.40%.

beats.headline: Shares fall 4.99% amid semiconductor sell-off
beats.explanation: Nvidia dropped 4.99% to $196.51 on 1.3 times average volume as AI hardware sentiment cooled on reports of Chinese semiconductor equipment developments and scrutiny around AI infrastructure financing. The decline was shared with key AI hardware peers, as competitor AMD dropped 5.17% and supplier Micron declined 2.25%, even while big tech customers Alphabet and Microsoft gained 2.13% and 1.94%.

beats.headline: Stock climbs 3.44% on winning SpaceX AI deal over AMD
beats.explanation: Nvidia rose 3.44% to $219.22 on 1.3 times average volume after securing a major AI infrastructure deal with SpaceX over competitor AMD. The advance was distinctly company-specific as AMD tumbled 7.04% and competitor Alphabet fell 4.03%, leaving Nvidia as a lone gainer among mega-cap tech names.

beats.headline: Shares surge 8.74% after strong earnings and guidance
beats.explanation: Nvidia surged 8.74% to $227.98 on 2.5 times average volume following its quarterly earnings report and robust forward revenue guidance. The rally drove company-specific gains over direct GPU rival AMD, which fell 0.89%, while supplier TSMC climbed 2.30% and competitor Broadcom rose 4.49%.

beats.headline: Shares give back 4.58% following post-earnings surge
beats.explanation: Nvidia dropped 4.58% to $217.55 on 1.6 times average volume, pulling back after its 8.74% earnings-driven surge the prior day. The decline was shared across semiconductor peers amid renewed interest rate worries, with competitor AMD down 2.33%, supplier TSMC falling 2.29%, and competitor Intel losing 2.85%, even as cloud customers Amazon and Microsoft advanced.
